en.headline: Tesla driver jailed 22 months for fatal amber-light crash in Yuen Long
en.dek: District Court sentences Ernest Au Yeung to 22 months and five years’ disqualification after he accelerated through an amber light and killed a 19-year-old pedestrian in 2024.
body: A 32-year-old man was sentenced on Thursday to 22 months in prison and disqualified from driving for five years after pleading guilty to dangerous driving causing death in a 2024 Yuen Long crash.

Deputy District Judge Chung Wai-keung said Ernest Au Yeung Shiu-hong accelerated his Tesla through an amber light on On Lok Road while already exceeding the 50 km/h limit, striking 19-year-old Pun Lisa as she crossed. The court accepted that the pedestrian signal was red for her, but held that a reasonable driver approaching a crossing must still protect other road users. Au Yeung told a probation officer he had been rushing to work in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The judge described the driving as extremely dangerous and irresponsible, placing the culpability in the middle-to-high range. Au Yeung had seven previous traffic convictions, including five for speeding, but no criminal record. The court noted his subsequent post-traumatic stress and major depressive disorder and the early guilty plea in mitigation, but said no sentence could undo the loss for the victim’s family.

Pun was thrown into the air, found unconscious at the scene and certified dead in hospital the same day. A reconstruction indicated the collision could have been avoided had the driver been travelling at the speed limit and braked promptly.

zh.headline: 元朗衝黃燈撞斃少女 Tesla司機判囚22個月停牌5年
zh.dek: 區域法院周四判處承認危險駕駛引致他人死亡的歐陽劭匡監禁22個月及停牌5年，指其駕駛態度極之危險。
body: 32歲男子歐陽劭匡周四在區域法院因2024年元朗一宗致命車禍被判監禁22個月，並取消駕駛資格5年。他早前承認危險駕駛引致他人死亡罪。
暫委法官鍾偉強指出，歐陽當時駕駛Tesla在安樂路已超速，見交通燈轉黃後加速通過，撞倒正在過路的19歲尼泊爾裔少女Pun Lisa。法官接納事主當時行人燈號為紅，但認為合理謹慎的駕駛者駛近行人過路處時仍須顧及行人安全。歐陽向感化官解釋當時趕往尖沙咀上班。
法官形容其駕駛態度極之危險及不負責任，危駕程度屬中至高。歐陽有7次交通紀錄，包括5次超速，但無案底。法院考慮其案後患創傷後壓力症及重度抑鬱、以及及早認罪而酌情減刑，但強調任何刑罰都無法挽回事主家人的傷痛。
事主被撞飛後不省人事，同日下午在醫院不治。交通意外重組顯示，若被告按限速行駛並及時煞車，意外本可避免。
